input: Find a local flea market to sell vintage finds

gold.taskTitle: Find a Local Flea Market to Sell Vintage Finds
gold.taskDescription: Research and identify a suitable local flea market where the user can set up a vendor booth to sell their vintage items.

questions.title: What city or neighborhood are you based in?
questions.description: Knowing the user's location helps narrow down nearby flea markets that are realistically accessible.

questions.title: What types of vintage items are you planning to sell?
questions.description: Understanding the product category helps match the user to markets that attract the right buyers for their specific items.

questions.title: How far are you willing to travel to the market?
questions.description: Establishes a maximum distance radius so only feasible market options are considered.

questions.title: Do you want a one-time spot or a recurring vendor booth?
questions.description: Determines whether the user needs a permanent or flexible vendor arrangement, which varies by market type.

questions.title: What is your budget for booth or table fees?
questions.description: Vendor fees vary widely between markets, so knowing the budget ensures the plan stays financially realistic.

questions.title: Which days of the week work best for you to vend?
questions.description: Flea markets operate on different schedules, so availability helps filter for markets that align with the user's free time.

questions.title: Have you sold at a flea market before?
questions.description: Knowing the user's experience level helps tailor the plan, such as whether to include steps for first-time vendor requirements like permits or setup guides.
